title: Hypersensitivity to adrenomedullin in post-traumatic headache: a randomized crossover study
title_zh: 创伤后头痛中对肾上腺髓质素的超敏反应：一项随机交叉研究
abstract: Abstract Adrenomedullin (ADM), a vasoactive member of the calcitonin peptide family with receptor-signalling overlap with calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), has emerged as a candidate therapeutic target in migraine. Given the striking clinical parallels between migraine and persistent post-traumatic headache (PTH), we investigated whether ADM-responsive signalling contributes to migraine-like headache in adults with persistent PTH attributed to mild traumatic brain injury. We conducted a single-centre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, two-way crossover study in adults with persistent PTH and no pre-trauma history of migraine. On two experimental days separated by at least 7 days, participants received 20-minute intravenous infusions of ADM (19.9 pmol kg⁻¹ min⁻¹) and isotonic saline as the matched inactive comparator (placebo) in randomised sequence. Headache outcomes were recorded for 12 hours. The primary outcome was the within-participant incidence of experimentally induced migraine-like headache. The secondary outcome was the within-participant difference in baseline-corrected area under the curve (AUC) for headache intensity from 0 to 12 hours. Of 158 individuals assessed for eligibility, 21 were randomised, completed both periods and were analysed. Participants had a mean age of 34.3 years, 19 (90%) were female, and 18 (86%) reported a migraine-like phenotype. Migraine-like headache occurred in 17 of 21 participants (81%) after ADM and four of 21 (19%) following placebo. Fourteen participants developed migraine-like only after ADM and one only following placebo, yielding a paired absolute risk difference of 61.9 percentage points (95% CI 29.7–80.6; one-sided P < 0.001; two-sided P = 0.001). Baseline-corrected headache-intensity AUC was higher after ADM than placebo (median 1,110 [IQR 315–2205] versus 420 [−160 to 565]; P = 0.006). Median time to onset of migraine-like headache was 30 minutes after ADM and 390 minutes following placebo. Fifteen participants reported that the ADM-induced headache resembled their usual migraine-like headache episodes, and rescue medication was used by 10 participants after ADM and two after placebo. These findings identify pronounced responsiveness to ADM-linked signalling in persistent PTH and support the ADM pathway as a candidate target for mechanism-based therapeutic development, pending confirmation in independent cohorts and complementary preclinical studies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 肾上腺髓质素（ADM）是降钙素肽家族中具有血管活性的成员，其受体信号通路与降钙素基因相关肽（CGRP）存在重叠，已成为偏头痛的潜在治疗靶点。鑒于偏头痛与持续性创伤后头痛（PTH）之间显著的临床相似性，我们调查了ADM响应性信号传导是否在因轻度创伤性脑损伤而持续性PTH的成年人中参与类似偏头痛的头痛。我们在持续性PTH且无创伤前偏头痛病史的成年人中进行了一项单中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、两方向交叉研究。在间隔至少7天的两个实验日，参与者接受随机顺序的20分钟静脉输注ADM（19.9 pmol kg⁻¹ min⁻¹）和作为匹配不活性对照（安慰剂）的等渗生理盐水。头痛结局记录持续12小时。主要结局是受试者内部实验诱发类似偏头痛头痛的发生率。次要结局是受试者内部头痛强度基线校正后0至12小时曲线下面积（AUC）的差异。在158名受评估资格的个体中，21人被随机入组、完成两个周期并纳入分析。参与者平均年龄34.3岁，19人（90%）为女性，18人（86%）报告了类似偏头痛的表型。ADM后，21人中有17人（81%）出现类似偏头痛头痛，而安慰剂后为4人（19%）。14名参与者仅在ADM后出现类似偏头痛头痛，1名仅在安慰剂后出现，配对绝对风险差为61.9个百分点（95% CI 29.7–80.6；单侧P < 0.001；双侧P = 0.001）。ADM后的基线校正头痛强度AUC高于安慰剂（中位数1,110 [IQR 315–2205] 对 420 [−160 to 565]；P = 0.006）。类似偏头痛头痛发病时间中位数为ADM后30分钟，安慰剂后390分钟。15名参与者报告ADM诱发的头痛与其常规类似偏头痛发作相似，10名参与者在ADM后和2名在安慰剂后使用了解救药物。这些发现提示持续性PTH中对ADM相关信号传导有明显的反应性，并支持ADM通路作为机制基础治疗开发的候选靶点，有待独立队列和互补的前期研究证实。
